release_notes: Orbitra 2.2.1: adds scheduled Link Checks for offers and domains (with bulk proxy import, pool rotation, redirect chain history, and Telegram alerts), hardens server-side URL fetches against private/LAN/metadata addresses via core/url_guard.php, adds Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt) as the 9th interface language across the panel and bots, adds auto-saved metrics and named metric presets in Analytics → Trends, keeps the main navbar visible in LeadForge and CRM, and expands the Partners catalog.
